title: I love it.
text: I love it.. First off, this is a functional piece. It's not some expensive designer looking rack. It's plastic, but sturdy enough. I love it and it makes organization so much easier and it holds so much in such a small space. I want my kitchen organized and streamlined for easy function and less mess. It's almost as good as having an assistant in the kitchen. I'm very pleased with it. I have family and friends that have are impressed by it also, because it holds so much more than spices. It holds everything you need to cook.  You can customize it with each meal, holding the items you'll be needing for that specific dinner. No scrambling to find your tools, utensils, and ingredients in order you'll need them. I just love it.
